caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular sheet with a central block of handwritten German text bordered by a colorful decorative frame. The frame is adorned with patterns and stylized motifs, including two large birds near the top corners. The birds have red and black bodies, yellow beaks, and are perched on swirling blue and brown stems with leaves. Four large tulip-shaped flowers, mostly red with dotted patterns, are placed in each corner. The border features light brown as the background color, and blue leaves and small red buds appear scattered along it, particularly at the sides and bottom. The inner border enclosing the text is lined with small red, blue, and gray triangles that alternate in color, creating a zigzag pattern. The aged paper has a mottled light brown color, with darker spots and visible creases around the edges.
title: Pa. German Birth Certificate
